headline: Indosolar Limited issues press release on Q2 and H1 FY27 financial performance
hook: Indosolar publishes Q2 FY27 financial results
summary: Indosolar Limited has submitted a press release to the stock exchanges detailing its financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.
